title: hypericum tetrapterum var. genuinum
intro: Hypericum tetrapterum var. genuinum, commonly known as Four-angled St. John's Wort, is a species of flowering plant in the St. John's Wort family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and anxiety, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Four-angled St. John's Wort include its sedative and analgesic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
